bio.es: Digna es la tía de Marta y una gran amiga de Isidro, por lo que siempre ha considerado a Fina como si fuera una hija para ella. Tras la muerte de su marido, descubre que él había sido homosexual y que pasó toda su vida ocultando sus verdaderos sentimientos, obligado a vivir una vida que nunca deseó por miedo al rechazo y a la condena de la sociedad. Por eso, cuando se entera de la relación entre Marta y Fina, les brinda todo su apoyo desde el primer momento porque no quiere que ellas tengan que sufrir el mismo destino que su marido.
bio.en: Digna is Marta's aunt and a great friend of Isidro, which is why she has always considered Fina as if she were a daughter to her. After her husband's death, she discovers that he had been homosexual and that he spent his whole life hiding his true feelings, forced to live a life he never wanted out of fear of society's rejection and condemnation. That is why, when she learns of the relationship between Marta and Fina, she gives them her full support from the very first moment, because she does not want them to suffer the same fate as her husband.
